This is supported by three distinct paths, all of which indicate that Selgantolimod targets a common intermediate, Magnesium levulinate, which in turn targets the Fc receptor IB. The high scores (0.7047) across these paths suggest a consistent and significant relationship, likely due to the shared biological role of Magnesium levulinate in modulating the Fc receptor IB. The mechanisms appear to involve a pathway where Selgantolimod influences the activity of Magnesium levulinate, which then affects the Fc receptor IB. While the exact nature of the interaction between Selgantolimod and Magnesium levulinate remains unclear, the evidence points to a coordinated regulatory role in the Fc receptor IB pathway. The integration of these paths highlights a plausible mechanism by which Selgantolimod may influence the Fc receptor IB, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
